{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify the premises
assert set(sales_df['channel'].unique()) == {'email', 'paid_search'}, "Channel values are not as expected."
assert set(sales_df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}, "Conversion values are not binary."

# Check if users are assigned to only one channel
assert len(sales_df) == len(sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']) + len(sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']), "Users are assigned to both channels or neither."

# Compute conversion rates
total_email = len(sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email'])
converted_email = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_email = converted_email / total_email


total_paid_search = len(sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search'])
converted_paid_search = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print results explicitly to ensure they are in the output
print("=== COMPUTED VALUES FOR EVIDENCE ===")
print(f"Total email users: {total_email}")
print(f"Email conversions: {converted_email}")
print(f"Email conversion rate: {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Total paid_search users: {total_paid_search}")
print(f"Paid_search conversions: {converted_paid_search}")
print(f"Paid_search conversion rate: {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Display cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
print("\n=== CROSS-TABULATION: channel vs customer_segment ===")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Display cross-tabulation of channel and customer_age to check for imbalance
print("\n=== CROSS-TABULATION: channel vs customer_age ===")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_age'], margins=True))"}
